items.title: Linde India secures 8-acre Sanand plot for semiconductor packaging gas facility
items.text: Linde India has acquired about 8 acres in Sanand, Gujarat for a gas facility serving semiconductor packaging units, and says it is in talks with potential customers on long-term supply contracts. Micron, CG Power and Kaynes Technology have packaging and testing projects in Sanand. It complements the air separation unit under development in Dholera for Tata Electronics' fab. Price and commissioning date were not disclosed; the shares stood at ₹6,189 on 28 Sep, up 0.76%.
